name: control-decks/endroit-operations
description: Delegate bounded contextual decisions and Home maintenance.

capabilities.description: Take every remaining decision needed to complete the bound objective using the most coherent choice available in current context.
Stop the active White Card operation without changing completed results.
Rebuild provider projections from canonical Home and Desk sources.
Inspect the current Home and return blocking, warning, and advisory findings.
Apply the Home-owned engineer Role to the current Occupant for the bound work.
Activate the Home-owned research Equipment for the bound work.
Retain the current object as inspectable Room-owned Material.
Accept the current object as explicit Room truth.
Deliver current Material through one resolved Route.
Archive current Material inside its owning Room.
